A '''raid''' on [[Kidriff 5]] was conducted by [[Wraith Squadron]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

==Background==
[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] flew the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]'' to the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]-allied urban world of [[Kidriff 5]], where they dropped off a pair of [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] operatives. Then, the ship left, seeking to attract the attention of Zsinj forces and fool them into believing it was the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==The battle==
Before the battle, [[Garik Loran|Garik "Face" Loran]] discovered that pilot [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]] was actually Gara Petothel, a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent and after TIE fighters run back from battle towards their base for regrouping, he confronted her and placed her under arrest. Petothel complied.

==Aftermath==
When hearing on public channel about Notsil's true identity, [[Myn Donos]] fired [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] towards her starfighter, but detonating it before impact, damaging [[Garik Loran]]'s [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] in the process, who was protecting her. Petothel, didn't believing Wraiths could protect her from Donos's attempt to kill her again before facing court martial, jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
